joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#P_Charge).charger_chargingState != "fullyCharged")
triggered = false
}
wait until((#P_Charge).charger_chargingState == "fullyCharged")
(#P_Speaker).speaker_speak("Charging is complete")
triggered = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 주차장의 차량 충전기가 완충될때마다, 스피커로 "충전이 완료되었습니다"라고 말해줘.
command_eng: Whenever the car charger in the parking lot is fully charged, speak "Charging is complete" through the speaker.
